messages.content: Use the supplied repository tools. Preserve unrelated behavior. Treat tool failures as observations and correct the action before retrying. Do not modify tests.

Implement the following requested change in the repository. Unicode spaces are stripped when parsing markdown text ``` In [1]: import mistune In [2]: md = mistune.create_markdown(escape=False, hard_wrap=True) In [3]: result = md('\u2003\u2003foo\nbar\n\n\u2003\u2003foobar') In [4]: print(result)

foo
bar

foobar

``` The output is missing the leading em spaces (\u2003) that were in the input text. The expected output should be: ```

\u2003\u2003foo
bar

\u2003\u2003foobar

``` This happens because the text is being stripped with `strip()` which removes all whitespace characters, including unicode spaces like em space. The parser should preserve these special unicode spaces. Scope of this editing session: update the following production files and report the resulting local change for handover: src/mistune/markdown.py. No full task validation has been performed in this session.
